description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPUser class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes properties and methods to represent and manage LDAP user data, such as user DN, username, names, email, and identification details. It incorporates validation, constants for maximum length constraints, and uses traits for logging and text manipulation.

classes.name: LDAPUser
classes.description: Represents an LDAP user with properties such as DN, username, names, email, and identifiers. Responsible for validation, setting, and getting LDAP user attributes, as well as retrieving search filter parameters and log info.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUserDN
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user, with validation for max length.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username of the LDAP user, with length validation.

methods.name: getUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the LDAP user, if set.

methods.name: setUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID of the LDAP user, with length validation.

methods.name: isUserEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the user is enabled.

methods.name: setUserEnabled
methods.description: Sets the user's enabled status.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name of the LDAP user, with max length validation.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the middle name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setMiddleName
methods.description: Sets the middle name, with max length validation.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name, with max length validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID, if set.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID, with validation for length.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email, if set.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email, validating format and length.

methods.name: setUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Assigns the LDAP lookup setting for search filtering.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Assigns the LDAP entry associated with this user.

methods.name: getEmployeeSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Extracts and returns search filter parameters based on the LDAP entry and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLogInfo
methods.description: Returns information suitable for logging, including DN and attributes.
